method: Each source frame occupies the number of sequential output fields given by the selected repeat pattern. Standard 2:3 uses 2,3,2,3 fields across four source frames and produces the output frame pairs AA, BB, BC, CD, DD; advanced 2:3:3:2 uses 2,3,3,2 and produces AA, BB, BC, CC, DD; 2:2 gives every source frame two fields. Integer cycle and remainder arithmetic determines total fields, complete and incomplete output frames, clean and mixed-source frames, and repeated fields. Rates use exact 24000/1001 and 30000/1001 fractions where applicable. The sequence starts on field 1. Complete cycles preserve running time; partial cycles report their own field-based duration and timing difference. Field dominance is not declared.
